name: Tan Chuan Rae Jovan
summary: I build systems that get used. I'm an Engineering Systems & Design student at SUTD and the founder of Radiant Digital, where I take products from a client conversation to a shipped app. My training is in optimisation, forecasting and operations; my habit is turning those models into software a business can run on. I care less about the elegant model than about the decision it changes.

artifacts.title: RAILWATCH — Rail Wear Forecasting
artifacts.summary: Forecasting system for SBS Transit that predicts rail wear with weighted regression, built on FastAPI and SQLite to support maintenance planning.

artifacts.title: LUMU — Wellness Companion App
artifacts.summary: Client-funded mental wellness app with an AI companion backed by a RAG psychoeducation library; scoped, contracted and built end to end for a public launch on both app stores.

artifacts.title: CADENCE — Client Acquisition System
artifacts.summary: Funnel system for service businesses covering landing pages, payments and AI follow-up, built on Next.js, Supabase and Stripe; first paying client signed.

whyMe: A capstone stalls when the analysis never leaves the spreadsheet. I close that gap: I can frame the problem as an operations or finance question, model it, and then build the working tool a partner can put in front of their team. I have scoped and delivered for paying clients, so I know how to keep a brief honest, a timeline real, and a stakeholder in the loop.
